system.name: Betelgeuse
system.description: A massive M-type red supergiant marking Orion's right shoulder, roughly 700 light-years away. One of the largest known stars by radius, Betelgeuse is expected to end its life in a spectacular core-collapse supernova within the next ~100,000 years.

betelgeuse.name: Betelgeuse
betelgeuse.description: An M2 Iab-0 red supergiant so enormous that if placed at the Sun's location it would engulf all the inner planets out to Jupiter. Betelgeuse dramatically dimmed in 2019–2020 — the so-called 'Great Dimming' — caused by a massive surface mass ejection that temporarily obscured part of its disc.
betelgeuse.funFact: Betelgeuse is so large that light takes about 4.5 hours to travel across its diameter — longer than it takes light from the Sun to reach Neptune.
